description: Read and write Airtable records (CRUD minus delete). Actions: 'list_records' (query a table with view/filter/sort/paging), 'get_record' (one record by id), 'create_records' (add up to 10), 'update_records' (partial-update up to 10 by id), and 'get_schema' (list tables and fields; needs the 'schema.bases:read' PAT scope, optional). The base id and table travel as call params — pass 'base_id'+'table' or paste an Airtable URL as 'base_url'. Authentication uses the 'airtable_pat' Personal Access Token injected by the host as a Bearer token; the tool never sees the raw value.

auth.instructions:
Airtable setup (3 steps):

1. Create a Personal Access Token -> https://airtable.com/create/tokens
   Scopes:
     - data.records:read   (required)
     - data.records:write  (required, for create/update)
     - schema.bases:read   (optional - only if the agent should see other tables in the base via get_schema)
   Access: under 'Access', add the base you want the agent to use.

2. Copy your base URL. Open the table in Airtable and copy the browser URL, e.g.:
   https://airtable.com/appXXXXXXXX/tblYYYYYYYY/viwZZZZZZZZ
   Put it in your agent's instructions so it knows which base/table to use.

3. Paste the token below.

Single table only? Skip schema.bases:read - the agent stays on the table from your URL. Want it to roam all tables in the base? Add schema.bases:read.

required_secrets.name: airtable_pat
required_secrets.prompt: Airtable Personal Access Token (from airtable.com/create/tokens, starts with 'pat')
